name: demo-resource
description: No tools; one resource (genes://panel) and one resource template (genes://panel/{symbol}).

interface.shortDescription: A gene panel exposed as MCP resources.
interface.longDescription: No tools, one fixed resource (genes://panel, a five-gene oncogene/tumour-suppressor panel as JSON) and one resource template (genes://panel/{symbol}) that the host or model reads by URI rather than calling as a tool.
defaultPrompt: Read the resource genes://panel/KRAS from demo-resource.
